children.value:
alātasya jvaladulmukasya parispandādbhramaṇādrātrāvagnimayaṃ cakraṃ
bhrāntyā yathā dṛśyate tathetyarthaḥ
yena svabhāvena praspandate yenopāyena na spandate

tatra vicāre
bhedāṃśo mithyā abhedāṃśo vāstava iti darśayati - abhinnāviti

ata-eva spandanirodhenobhayanāśārtha jñānakramaśca śāstre darśita ityāha
- dvau kramāviti
tatrādyaṃ kramaṃ prathamaṃ jijñāsamāno rāmaḥ pṛcchati - kadeti

nanu prāṇo bahireva yāti dehe tvapānādayo'nye vāyavaḥ saṃcaranti tatrāha -
tasyeti

āpomayaḥ prāṇaḥ iti
etamevāṅgirasaṃ manyante prāṇo vā aṅgānāṃ rasaḥ ca śruteriti bhāvaḥ

prāṇabandhanaṃ hi somya manaḥ tasya puruṣavidhatāmanvayaṃ puruṣavidhaḥ
ityādiśruteriti bhāvaḥ

āgamabhūsaṇāḥ prāṇabandhanaṃ hi
somya manaḥ prāṇādvā eṣa udeti prāṇe'stameti prāṇaṃ tarhi vāgapyeti prāṇaṃ
cakṣuḥ prāṇaṃ śrotram ityādiśrutirahasyajñāḥ
astvevaṃ tataḥ kiṃ tatrāha - mana iti

dehalakṣaṇe svagehe hṛdayādisthāneṣu dvāsaptatisahasranāḍībhedeṣu ca aniśaṃ
caratāṃ gaganeṣu mukhanāsikādicchidreṣu bāhyākāśe ca gamanaśīlānām

prathamaṃ sthūle śikhare candrabimbe maṇidevatāmūrtyādau vā yatraiva mano'sya
ramate tatraiva nirodho'bhyasanīya ityāha - yathābhivāñchiteti

pūrakakumbhakarecakakrameṇa prāṇanirodhasahitādvā
durdāntacittaspandanirodhaḥ kārya ityāha - pūraketi

dīrghoccāritapraṇavaturyamātrālambanayogādvā saṃvido bāhyārthasaṃvedanasya
suṣupte ātyantikoparame jāte sati

idānīṃ recakapūrakayorekaikasyāpi śvāsapraśvāsaśithilīkaraṇe
kāladairghyābhivardhanasahitadhyānābhyāsādapi tannirodha ityāha - recake iti
dvābhyām

sphāre vipulībhūte prāṇe chinnābhravat kramāt khaṃ śūnyabhāvaṃ
bāhyākāśaṃ vā āgate aṅgarandhrāṇi nāsāvivarāṇi na spṛśati sati

antaḥpūrātpūraṇādgirau ghanā meghā iva yāvatpūrti mandamupacīyamāne sthite
niścale sati

pūrtyanantaraṃ kumbhake pūrṇakumbhavadanantaṃ kālaṃ stambhite prāṇe
paritiṣṭhati sati

uktatrividhaprāṇāyāmakramaśca pātañjale śāstre prapañcitaḥ
tasminsati śvāsapraśvāsayorgativicchedaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ

tasminprāgukte
āsanajaye sati bāhyasya vāyorāyamanaṃ śvāsaḥ kauṣṭhyasya vāyornissāraṇaṃ
praśvāsaḥ tayorgativiccheda ubhayābhāvalakṣaṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ

yathā tapte
nyastamupale jalaṃ sarvataḥ saṃkocamāpadyate tathā dvayoryugapadgatyabhāva iti

trayo'pyete deśaparidṛṣṭāḥ bahistūlalavaspandādinā antarnābhyādispandādinā
ca iyānasya viṣayo deśa iti

saṃkhyābhiḥ paridṛṣṭā etāvatsaṃkhyaśvāsapraśvāsakālaiḥ prathamo
dvitīyastṛtīya udbodhita iti
evaṃ mṛdurevaṃ madhya evaṃ tīvra iti ca

sa
khalvevamabhyastaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ
pravikasvaratūlapiṇḍavanmandākṛṣṭabisatantuvadvā dairghyasaukṣmyāpannaiḥ
prāṇairdīrghaḥ sūkṣmaśca bhavatītyarthaḥ

abhyāsātstambhite prāṇe ityanena ca
tatparipākalabhyaścaturtho'pi prakāraḥ sūcitaḥ

so'pi patañjalinā darśitaḥ
bāhyābhyantaraviṣayākṣepī caturthaḥ iti

tapi na paramaṃ prāṇāyāmāttato
viśuddhirmalānāṃ dīptiśca jñānasyeti bhāṣyam

antareṇa tāluke ya eṣa stana ivāvalambate sendrayoniḥ
iti śruteḥ

tāṃ parivṛttayā
vardhanābhyāsādiprayatnādantaḥprāṇasaṃcāramārge mūrdharandhre
praveśyamānayā jihvayā ākramya niṣpīḍyādhaḥkṛtya prāṇe ūrdhvarandhre
brahmarandhre gate praveśya dhārite satītyarthaḥ

tatprakāraśca bhagavatā skandenoktaḥ rasanāṃ tāluvivare
nidhāyordhvamukho'mṛtam
ūrdhvajihvaḥ sthiro bhūtvā somapānaṃ karoti yaḥ

māsārdhena na saṃdeho
mṛtyuṃ jayati yogavit

ākāśaṃ ca marīcivārisadṛśaṃ
yadbrahmarandhrasthitaṃ yannāthena sadāśivena sahitaṃ śāntaṃ hakārākṣaram

prāṇaṃ vilīya pañcaghaṭikaṃ cittānvitaṃ dhārayedeṣā
mokṣakavāṭapāṭanapaṭuḥ proktā nabhodhāraṇā

samastāḥ kalanā vikārāstadunmukte'ta-eva na kiṃcinnāmani sūkṣme
hārdākāśe saṃvidi antarbāhyasaṃvedanavṛttimātre nirvikalpasamādhinā
līnāyāṃ satyām

dvādaśāntaṃ brahmarandhrasthānaṃ tadge prāṇe galitaprāye
saṃvṛtte sati

ciranirodhācchāntau uparame sati tathā jihvāgre prāṇe ca prāguktarītyā
kapālakuharapraveśādantaṃ dvādaśāntamupāgate sati ketane bhrūmadhye
avimuktasthāne ya eṣo'kṣaro'nantaḥ iti jābālaśrutyāadiprasiddhe cetane
cinmātrasvabhāve parameśvare ātmatayā buddhe satītyarthaḥ

khecarīmudrāpi
skandenoktā - kapālakuhare jihvā praviṣṭā viparītagā
na pīḍyate sa rogeṇa na ca lipyeta karmaṇā
bādhyate na sa kālena yo mudrāṃ vetti khecarīm

gurorīśvarasya vā anugrahātkākatālīyanyāyena jhaṭityevodbhūte jñāne
jhaṭityeva cittavikalpopaśamādvā tannirodha ityāha - jhaṭityeveti

atha yadidamasminbrahmapure daharaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ veśma
daharo'sminnantarākāśaḥ ityādiśrutiprasiddhe daharākāśe vā ciraṃ
cittaniveśāttatsākṣātkāre tatsiddhirityāha - ciramiti

tathācoktaṃ pātañjale
- hṛdaye cittasaṃvitsvārthasaṃyamātpuruṣajñānam iti ca

hṛdayaśabdasya puṇḍarīkākāramāṃsaviśeṣe manasi paramātmani ca
prayogadarśanātsaṃdihānasya praśnaḥ
tatra māṃsamanasoḥ paricchinnatvādaikyameva prakalpya dvedhā vibhāgo bodhyaḥ

nanu ātmani hṛdayaśabdo hṛdayamātrasthitikatvādgauṇaḥ kiṃ na
syādityāśaṅkyāha - tadantare ceti
asmindyāvāpṛthivī antareva samāhite iti śruteriti bhāvaḥ

haṭhānnirodhe tu
rogādyā bādhā syādeveti bhāvaḥ
yathāvāsanaṃ yadā yā yā vāsanā udbhavanti tadā tattannirodhāyetyarthaḥ

athavā
mumukṣāvāsanāyāṃ mokṣaphalena saphalo bhogavāsanāyāṃ tu
tattadbhogasiddhivaicitryaphalena saphala ityarthaḥ

ata-eva tattatsiddhiphalabhedārthapātañjalaśāstre
bhrūmadhyādisthānabhedena dhāraṇābhedā darśitā ityāśayenāha -
bhrūnāseti / tālusaṃsthā tālusaṃsthānaṃ kaṇṭhāgrādārabhya
dvādaśāṅgulimitapradeśakoṭiḥ sīmā dvādaśāntaḥ

yathāha patañjaliḥ nābhicakre kāyavyūhajñānam
kaṇṭhakūpe kṣutpipāsānivṛttiḥ kūrmanāḍyāṃ sthairyam kaṇṭhakūpādadhaḥ
kūrmapṛṣṭhavadunnatapradeśe kūrmanāḍī prasiddhā mūrdhajyotiṣi
siddhadarśanam ityādi
sā yathā dūre gatvā tatraiva līyate tadvat
jihvayākramya ghaṇṭikām iti yatprāguktaṃ tatropāyamāha - bhūya iti

eteṣāṃ samādhibhedānāṃ tattatsiddhiphaleṣu vikalpabahulatve'pi niṣkāmasya
paramopaśamaphale avikalpataiva sarveṣāmityāha - vikalpeti
vāsanāvalitaṃ mano janmaśarīraṃ tatra prāṇaṃ cābhimānena gṛhṇāti

ata-eva vināśitvādidharmake jagati na kaścidapi brahmaṇo
dṛṣṭānto'stītyāha - vināśitvāditi
yadi na kaściddṛṣṭāntastarhi kathaṃ tatparicayastatrāha - svādanīti

phalamataḥ upapatteḥ iti nyāyādvicitrakarmaphalodayakṣayanimittatayā vā
tatpariceyamityāha - yasmāditi

ata-eva sakaleṣu
saṃvyavahāreṣu samo harṣaviṣādaśūnya āśayo yasya
